Policy, budget, confidence, repair, and completion gates remain TUI-native decisions; GUI may display state or collect confirmation only.
Provider routing must fail closed when the selected route is unavailable; no silent OpenAI fallback is allowed.

It consumes optional vision sense output, returns refs-first results or approvalRequest, models multi-screen/multi-cursor collaboration through actor cursors plus scoped executor scheduling, treats real OS multi-pointer only as an optional backend adapter, and never imports GUI implementation.
